Explanation of Detection Conditions | Selection | Purpose | |---|---| | **`selection_image`** | Restricts the detection to only Windows PowerShell (`powershell.exe`) and PowerShell Core (`pwsh.exe`). This prevents noise from other scripting hosts. | | **`selection_encoded`** | Identifies the use of **base64 payload delivery**.
